plans.source: ADR 0005 §15.3 (ADR 0004 §15 Q10 re-derived as query plans)
plans.history: SEARCH scrobbles_owner_time (did=?), no SCAN, no temporary B-tree; a deep page's search is bounded by (listened_at,uri)<(?,?) and seeks from the cursor's last row; delete visibility SEARCHes operations_scrobble_delete_target by did and rkey
plans.global: scrobbles_global_time in order, no SCAN, no temporary B-tree; a deep page's search is bounded by (listened_at,uri)<(?,?) and seeks from the cursor's last row; delete visibility SEARCHes operations_scrobble_delete_target by did and rkey
plans.following: SEARCH scrobbles_owner_time per followee and follows_actor_subject, no SCAN; a deep page's search is bounded by (listened_at,uri)<(?,?) and seeks from the cursor's last row; delete visibility SEARCHes operations_scrobble_delete_target by did and rkey
plans.stats: every scrobbles statement SEARCHes scrobbles_owner_time or scrobbles_stats by DID, no SCAN; in a 7d, 30d or 365d window every scrobbles SEARCH is bounded by did=? AND listened_at>? AND listened_at<?; delete visibility SEARCHes operations_scrobble_delete_target by did and rkey

followUps.summary: Following feed, first page: the viewer follows only 3 accounts with 20 listens each, spread over two years of a 20,060-row visible timeline. p50 0.464 ms, p95 0.725 ms for 20 rows (the dense first page of this kind of read: p50 0.353 ms; scrobbles plan: SEARCH s USING INDEX scrobbles_owner_time (did=?); USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY). SQLite walks each followee's scrobbles_owner_time range (up to L + 1 rows each) and merges the walks in a temporary B-tree, so the cost grows with the number of followees, not with the size of the global timeline. Measured and reported, not asserted (Q10).

Following feed, deep page (depth 30): the viewer follows only 3 accounts with 20 listens each, spread over two years of a 20,060-row visible timeline. p50 0.359 ms, p95 0.402 ms for 20 rows (the dense first page of this kind of read: p50 0.353 ms; scrobbles plan: SEARCH s USING INDEX scrobbles_owner_time (did=? AND (listened_at,uri)<(?,?)); USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY). The same per-followee walks start below the cursor, so a deep page costs no more than a first page. Measured and reported, not asserted (Q10).

Global feed, first page: the newest 1,000 rows belong to an owner deactivated by the production markInactive (rows kept, owner hidden), above a 20,060-row visible timeline. p50 0.745 ms, p95 0.793 ms for 20 rows (the dense first page of this kind of read: p50 0.232 ms; scrobbles plan: SCAN s USING INDEX scrobbles_global_time). The scrobbles_global_time walk visits and discards every hidden row above the first visible one, each with its owner-visibility probe, so the cost grows linearly with the hidden owner's newest rows. Candidate fixes (not decided): keep hidden owners' rows out of the global walk, for example by deleting them on deactivation and re-snapshotting on reactivation, or a visibility column in the global index. Measured and reported, not asserted (Q10).
